reports.title: Zoom Communications Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027

lines: •Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2027: Total revenue is expected to be between $1.293 billion and $1.298 billion and revenue in constant currency is expected to be between $1.293 billion and $1.298 billion.
•Full Fiscal Year 2027: Total revenue is expected to be between $5.100 billion and $5.105 billion and revenue in constant currency is expected to be between $5.086 billion and $5.091 billion.

desk.headline: Revenue up 4.9% to $1.29bn and adjusted EPS of $1.59, both above estimates; full-year outlook raised; first dividend of $0.25

other.label: Diluted EPS (GAAP)
other.change: vs $2.01 a year ago, which included large investment gains

results: Revenue rose 4.9% to $1.29bn, above both the $1.28bn estimate and Zoom's own $1.275–1.280bn guide; adjusted EPS of $1.59 beat the $1.49 estimate.
Enterprise revenue grew 8.6% to $805.4m, while Online (self-serve) revenue slipped 0.6% to $485.3m; Online monthly churn ticked up to 2.8% from 2.7%.
Non-GAAP operating margin was 41.6%. GAAP net income halved to $312.4m, mainly because last year's quarter had $406.1m of investment gains versus $10.2m now.
Free cash flow fell to $558.1m from $614.3m; cash and marketable securities were $7.3bn.
Zoom bought back about 3.9m shares and started a quarterly dividend of $0.25 a share, payable 17 Dec 2026.

guidance.summary: Zoom raised its full-year revenue, operating profit and adjusted EPS ranges and kept its free cash flow outlook unchanged. It also gave a Q4 outlook; one news report called it broadly in line with expectations, without figures.

points: CEO Eric Yuan said Enterprise growth was the fastest in 13 quarters, led by the Customer Experience (contact centre) products.
He said Customer Experience posted a seventh straight quarter of high double-digit ARR growth.
Management framed the new dividend and ongoing buybacks as possible alongside continued investment in growth.
call.source: Press release CEO comments (Exhibit 99.1); results coverage: Longbridge (Zhitong Finance), 23 Nov 2026. No detailed call coverage found.

watch: Whether Enterprise growth keeps accelerating while Online revenue and churn hold steady.
Delivery on the raised full-year outlook in Q4.
Swings in investment gains, which can move GAAP profit sharply from quarter to quarter.
